posts.headline: Fourteen straight editions of hunting the African Bald Fraud and mjwithgoldhoops is still sitting at 9-2 with the league's best points total at 1521.56 — a middle-tier pedigree has no business looking this much like a contender.
posts.detail: A 15-13 career record and a 4th-place average finish said 'respectable but forgettable,' yet here's mjwithgoldhoops running away with both the record AND scoring crown this deep into the season.

posts.headline: Fourteen straight editions of burying Thicks and the reigning champ is STILL dragging the league's worst points-for at 1178.5 while somehow sitting pretty at 7-4.
posts.detail: One title and a 14-14 career record earns zero slack when your 7-4 record is being carried by schedule luck instead of actual offense — the ring means nothing if you're outscored by teams with losing records.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner's 20-8, 1.5-average-finish dynasty keeps rotting at 3-8, and Put it in Ra is now firmly out of the playoff conversation it used to own.
posts.detail: Back-to-back championship appearances built that .714 career win pct, but 1187.78 points and a 3-8 record say this version of One Nut Barner has nothing left in the tank.

posts.headline: BIBLE OR THE BELT is 0-11 for the fourteenth edition running, and Eli's Ultimate Light Skin has transcended losing into full biblical plague status.
posts.detail: A once-respectable 13-14-1 career record has been buried alive this season — drafting a defensive player first overall was the original sin, and the 0-11 record is the wages thereof.

posts.headline: Shake N Bakers are 8-3 with 1511.84 points, second-best in the league, and triciagloston is still being treated like an afterthought in every conversation.
posts.detail: A rookie-year 6-7-1 pedigree never predicted this — a newcomer putting up the league's second-highest point total deserves more than silence at this point.
